note: Adapted from Sands' (1972) species-level description of Anenteotermes cnaphorus, originally in English; the species is soldierless; measurement-table headings, figure numbers, type locality and nest records are not translated, numbers in the tables partly destroyed by OCR are omitted, and the upper limit of the composite ratio of the left mandible of the alate, damaged in the OCR as I0-10, is not given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Comparisons with A. amachetus, A. ateuchestes and A. cicur are given under those species. A. disluctans has shorter apical mandibular teeth, a more prominent postclypeus with an evenly rounded posterior margin and a more distinct fontanelle; A. hemerus is much larger, with a less swollen postclypeus and shorter apical teeth; A. improcinctus and A. nanus are smaller, with the compound eyes distinctly flattened against the sides of the head; A. improelatans has a broader constriction of the meso- and metathorax, an evenly rounded posterior margin of the postclypeus and a longer first marginal tooth of the right mandible; A. polyscolus is smaller and often has a large, conspicuous oval fontanelle. In the worker the enteric valve appendages are weakly developed in all species except A. polyscolus; pad 3 is most specialized and most prolonged in A. polyscolus, and in the present species it is shorter, slightly broader and more abruptly contracted towards the apex. In the present species the apical mandibular teeth are slightly longer, the anterior tibia slightly less swollen and the body generally slightly longer; the abdomen is distinctly dehiscent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, pilosity yellow, rather dense but short and fine, inconspicuous. Postclypeus strongly swollen, Pcl/W 0.31–0.34, Pcl/Ri 2.78–2.86. Apical teeth of the mandibles rather short, La/Li 0.64–0.66, Ra/Ri 0.84–0.89; accessory marginal tooth of the left mandible separated from the molar prominence in surface view by a distinct notch, composite ratio 13.89–14.30; first marginal tooth of the right mandible distinctly behind the line from the apical tooth to the second marginal tooth, the anterior margin shorter than that of the second, composite ratio 18.20–19.20. Anterior tibia weakly swollen, T1/Tw 4.11–4.23, the third apical spur about half the length of the other two spurs. Overlap of midgut and hindgut more than four times the width of the midgut at the origin of the Malpighian tubules, the posterior end of the midgut slightly swollen; enteric valve seat with two weakly developed opposing lobes, connected by a short distinct neck to the second paunch, lateral in the unopened abdomen; endopads at positions 1 and 2 retracted, very small, the surface scaly, with at most one or two small spines; pad at position 3 projecting through the valve opening, contracted towards the apex, its rim bearing a ring of 10–12 slender comb-like spines, the proximal scales of the pad additionally with distinct spines at the posterior end; pad at position 4 retracted, about twice the size of pads 1 and 2, the posterior margin of the scales with distinct spines; membranous wall between and outside the pads with sparse minute spines.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown (from a queen, the colour possibly faded), darker above the ocelli; fontanelle elongate-oval, outline irregular, rather indistinct, covered by setae, as large as or slightly smaller than an ocellus, slightly concave, brown; central spot oval, almost flat, very small, concolorous with the head capsule; postclypeus brown, labrum yellowish brown; frontal mark an indistinct, slightly concave brown crescent; antennae yellowish brown. Pronotum brown, meso- and metanotum yellowish brown, transverse sutures present; femora and tibiae pale yellowish brown, tarsi yellow. Abdominal tergites brown, sternites yellowish brown laterally and yellow medially, spiracles concolorous with the sclerites; cerci yellow. Posterior margin of the head capsule evenly rounded; ocelli medium-sized, the distance to the compound eye less than half their own minimum diameter; postclypeus moderately swollen, Pcl/W 0.29–0.31, the posterior margin slightly irregularly arcuate, median suture present. Apical teeth of the mandibles short, La/Li 0.60–0.64, Ra/Ri 0.83–0.89; accessory marginal tooth of the left mandible remote from the molar prominence in surface view; first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly behind the line from the apical tooth to the second marginal tooth, the anterior margins of the marginal teeth about equal, composite ratio 17.30–19.40. Pilosity of the head capsule dense and rather even, forming a coarse felt, with many projecting setae, yellowish brown.
